description:
Why won't a grizzly bear try to kill a wolf pack, a porcupine or a bull bison? Doug follows a 300 kg grizzly through everything that would cost it a dinner, a face, its bones, its cubs or its life, from Yellowstone wolves to the Amur tiger that eats brown bears, and finally the animal grizzlies avoid most of all.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
